clock_policy.notes: Datacenter card: natural clock, no lock (docs/perf/README.md section 5). There is no sudo on this box, so nothing is applied and any lock left by another session cannot be reset; the policy is verified by observation instead: a step whose busy samples, those free of power, thermal and slowdown limits, never reach the card's maximum SM clock is flagged in the manifest.

notes: Filled on 2026-10-01 from the machine itself (pip list of the interpreter, nvidia-smi).

Package keys are distribution names: deep_gemm is the sgl-deep-gemm distribution. Every package of the harness's list that the environment has installed is pinned, plus nvidia-cublas and nvidia-cuda-nvrtc (the cuBLAS and NVRTC builds torch loads); any change to one of them is drift.

The environment, the CUDA_HOME and the unset knobs are those of the chains that produced the 2026-10-01 tables: /data/bench-runs/fso_release_perf_20261001/h200/scripts/run_stage1.sh and /data/bench-runs/h200_moe_tables_20261001/scripts/run_chain.sh.

The sm_90 kernels are compiled by the NVRTC bundled with fish_scales_ops (since 9cf0a46), never by the copy torch loads. Since 2026-10-05 the bundled NVRTC is 13.0.88, the same version the torch 2.13.0+cu130 wheel depends on, so jit_compiler_sm90() must name NVRTC 13.0 and the bundled path.

2026-10-05: the card is GPU 0 (PCI 8F:00.0, GPU-e87af6ea), granted for the 0.2.0 tables measured from the release wheel. The card of the 2026-10-01 runs, GPU 6 (PCI CB:00.0, GPU-f7556d6e), has run another tenant's service since 2026-10-01, and the harness refuses a card with a compute process.

2026-10-05: The sglang Triton comparators read their MoE tile configs from SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR, a pinned copy of apex's own config tree (apex-fish-inference cfed1d25, sglang_fish/sglang_fish/layers/moe/moe_runner/triton_utils/configs; 370 files, MANIFEST.md5 sha256 prefix 366a34a36d026df0), so the comparator column runs the configs apex serves with when it does not use fso. Each comparator row records the file sglang resolved for the gate_up and the down GEMM (moe_config).
